## If it changes a check

- [ ] A case it must catch, as a test
- [ ] A negative control: a test that fails if the check is removed or loosened by one unit
- [ ] If something can be absent (a board, a resume, a facts sheet, a log): it reports NOT EVALUABLE (exit 2), never clean or zero

## Data and credit

- [ ] Demo and test data are invented: no real posting, employer, person, resume or exam question
- [ ] Anything adapted from elsewhere is credited (README, and NOTICE or THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES if its license requires one)
